Finite gas consumption equals summed nozzle impulse divided by effective exhaust velocity

A full roll is a six-DOF actuator maneuver with inversion, ballistic descent and recovery
180° arch traversal continuously climbs from ground and stops upside down
Mode takeover, non-finite input guards and scenario resets remain finite
Normal test runs reject a hidden recovery instead of accepting a shortened simulation
Collision geometry exposes every static collider, including arch and boundaries

CSV schema contains quaternion, gas temperature and both nozzle command and delivered force
World-space exhaust preserves force sign and does not attach old gas to a moving vehicle

checks: Exported model build identity matches the source hashes of the solver, fixture, protocol and imported geometry
Isolated hover captures the same horizontal reference as its initial state and reports external through-flow separately from tank depletion
Finite hover distinguishes capacity loss, sustained tracking error and ground contact while conserving gas mass
Matched attitude A/B changes only the real stabilizer and requires a sustained low-error low-angular-rate recovery
Roll separates complete rotation, pre-contact velocity and confirmed landing; intentional descent is not a height-hold failure and rejected maneuvers have no fabricated samples
Single-factor friction sweep keeps identical initial conditions and produces monotonic measured brake distances with confirmed stops
Fixed-wheel protocol exposes its assistance override while fixed-driver A/B retains an actual difference in road-wheel angle and logs speed accuracy
Identical model and protocol reproduce complete source curves at uniform 20 Hz and protocol identity ignores parameter ordering
Study archive import revalidates frozen requests, ignores supplied metrics and rejects oversized, non-finite or scientifically inapplicable protocols
60–160 km/h brief keyboard turns remain below one degree sideslip and settle without resetting pose or velocity
Ackermann inner and outer angles differ; disabling assistance permits real saturation while every combined tire force remains friction-bounded
Normal E enters a bounded climb-rate controller, release brakes the rise; the separately labelled manual mode retains full physical thrust
Temperature-pressure exhaust stays below the ideal energy limit, cools, and conserves actual mass flow and delivered impulse
Finite ground and airborne ballistic rolls land softly without hull impacts; gas and attitude prechecks reject infeasible launches without changing mode
Independent research fixtures are deterministic, retain applied parameters and assumptions, and record uniform 20 Hz source data
The local radio includes instrumental, English and Chinese recordings with explicit attribution licenses and matching asset hashes
